scope: legacy static whole-DSDT A/B only; address-free SSDT is a separate implementation
reason: Control A boot reported a closed lid while the user confirmed the lid was open, causing repeated logind suspend requests. The control failed basic validation.
recovery: Native UKI and original firmware table metadata verified; lid open and no automatic suspend for over 7 minutes. A/B entries and images removed.
design_flaw: Static whole-DSDT reuse did not account for per-boot OperationRegion address fixups.
